representation.name: miRNA Ct row-wise t-test with p.adjust
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[1]
outfile <- args[2]
summaryfile <- args[3]
dat <- read.delim(infile, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("NAN", "NaN", "NA", ""))
stopifnot(ncol(dat) >= 3)
patient_cols <- grep("^P_", names(dat), value = TRUE)
control_cols <- grep("^C_", names(dat), value = TRUE)
if (length(patient_cols) == 0 || length(control_cols) == 0) stop("Could not identify patient/control columns")
pvals <- numeric(nrow(dat))
mean_patient <- numeric(nrow(dat))
mean_control <- numeric(nrow(dat))
n_patient <- integer(nrow(dat))
n_control <- integer(nrow(dat))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(dat))) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(dat[i, patient_cols], use.names = FALSE)))
  y <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(dat[i, control_cols], use.names = FALSE)))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]
  n_patient[i] <- length(x)
  n_control[i] <- length(y)
  mean_patient[i] <- if (length(x) > 0) mean(x) else NA_real_
  mean_control[i] <- if (length(y) > 0) mean(y) else NA_real_
  if (length(x) >= 2 && length(y) >= 2) {
    tt <- try(t.test(x, y, alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
    pvals[i] <- if (inherits(tt, "try-error")) NA_real_ else tt$p.value
  } else {
    pvals[i] <- NA_real_
  }
}
p_bonf <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "bonferroni")
p_by <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BY")
sig_bonf <- !is.na(p_bonf) & p_bonf <= 0.05
sig_by <- !is.na(p_by) & p_by <= 0.05
res <- data.frame(
  miRNA = dat[[1]],
  n_patient = n_patient,
  n_control = n_control,
  mean_patient_Ct = mean_patient,
  mean_control_Ct = mean_control,
  patient_minus_control_mean_Ct = mean_patient - mean_control,
  p_value = pvals,
  p_bonferroni = p_bonf,
  p_benjamini_yekutieli = p_by,
  significant_bonferroni = sig_bonf,
  significant_benjamini_yekutieli = sig_by,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(res, file = outfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
counts <- data.frame(
  method = c("Bonferroni", "Benjamini-Yekutieli"),
  threshold = c(0.05, 0.05),
  significant_count = c(sum(sig_bonf), sum(sig_by)),
  total_miRNAs = c(nrow(dat), nrow(dat)),
  ratio_answer = c(paste0(sum(sig_bonf), ":", sum(sig_by)), paste0(sum(sig_bonf), ":", sum(sig_by))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(counts, file = summaryfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.input.path)" results.tsv summary.tsv

control_cols <- grep("^C_", names(dat), value = TRUE)
if (length(patient_cols) == 0 || length(control_cols) == 0) stop("Could not identify patient/control columns")
pvals <- numeric(nrow(dat))
mean_patient <- numeric(nrow(dat))
mean_control <- numeric(nrow(dat))
n_patient <- integer(nrow(dat))
n_control <- integer(nrow(dat))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(dat))) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(dat[i, patient_cols], use.names = FALSE)))
  y <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(dat[i, control_cols], use.names = FALSE)))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]
  n_patient[i] <- length(x)
  n_control[i] <- length(y)
  mean_patient[i] <- if (length(x) > 0) mean(x) else NA_real_
  mean_control[i] <- if (length(y) > 0) mean(y) else NA_real_
  if (length(x) >= 2 && length(y) >= 2) {
    tt <- try(t.test(x, y, alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
    pvals[i] <- if (inherits(tt, "try-error")) NA_real_ else tt$p.value
  } else {
    pvals[i] <- NA_real_
  }
}
p_bonf <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "bonferroni")
p_by <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BY")
sig_bonf <- !is.na(p_bonf) & p_bonf <= 0.05
sig_by <- !is.na(p_by) & p_by <= 0.05
res <- data.frame(
  miRNA = dat[[1]],
  n_patient = n_patient,
  n_control = n_control,
  mean_patient_Ct = mean_patient,
  mean_control_Ct = mean_control,
  patient_minus_control_mean_Ct = mean_patient - mean_control,
  p_value = pvals,
  p_bonferroni = p_bonf,
  p_benjamini_yekutieli = p_by,
  significant_bonferroni = sig_bonf,
  significant_benjamini_yekutieli = sig_by,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(res, file = outfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
counts <- data.frame(
  method = c("Bonferroni", "Benjamini-Yekutieli"),
  threshold = c(0.05, 0.05),
  significant_count = c(sum(sig_bonf), sum(sig_by)),
  total_miRNAs = c(nrow(dat), nrow(dat)),
  ratio_answer = c(paste0(sum(sig_bonf), ":", sum(sig_by)), paste0(sum(sig_bonf), ":", sum(sig_by))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(counts, file = summaryfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
